_about: Everything Q-Lou says at the table. Plain text, edit by hand, no code. Each key holds a list; the game picks one line from the list (the same one on both phones).

Placeholders: {a} and {b} are the two nicknames (host first). {card} {ca} {cb} are card names. {n} {na} {nb} are counts. {sa} {sb} are the Qloo scores. {guess} is the plain model's guess. {pool} is the artist count. {payer} and {other} are nicknames at the end.
Rules of the voice: he only talks about what he can see (the cards, the numbers, the clock). Never feelings. Funny about his own limits. Sometimes nice to both. Short. No em-dashes.
Lines under 'cards' and 'pairs' are kept for later; the table says one thing per round now.
deal: Four cards, one of each suit. Tap any that aren't you and I'll swap them. Keep what's true.
Four cards. Tap the ones that aren't you and I swap them. Keep what's true.
One card per suit, four cards. Tap what isn't you. I'll swap it.

toss: Four cards, one of each suit. Tap any that aren't you and I'll swap them. Keep what's true.
Four cards. Tap the ones that aren't you and I swap them. Keep what's true.
One card per suit, four cards. Tap what isn't you. I'll swap it.
r1: Three rounds, one card each. First: drag the card that's most you into the gold slot. I turn both over together.
Round one. Drag the card that's most you into the gold slot. {b} is choosing too.
Most you first. Drag it into the gold slot. I'll show you both at once.
r2: Round two. The card that's also you.
Round two. Also you. Drag it in.
r3: Last card. The one that's a bit you.
Round three. A bit you. Last one.
play: Round two. Three cards, most you on top.
Round two. Three on the table. Top slot is the one you'd defend.
Round two. Put three down. Order matters, I'm counting.
reveal: Round three. Let's see what we've got.
Round three. I flip, you answer for it.

both_same: Both of you swapped out {card}. Noted.
{card}, swapped out by both. I'll remember that at pick time.

waiting: {b} is taking their time. The good ones do.
Give {b} a second. Cards are personal.
waiting_long: Still waiting on {b}. I've waited longer for worse.
{b} is deliberating. Jukebox hasn't moved either.
reveal_open: Here we go. Top cards first.

Early bird: {a} leads with Early bird. The bar opens at eleven, just so you know.
Early bird on top for {a}. Sunrise person at a jukebox. Respect.
Night owl: Night owl for {a}. This is your hour.
{a} put Night owl on top. The jukebox agrees with you.
Road trips: Road trips, top of the stack for {a}. Windows down is a genre.
{a} leads with Road trips. I know that playlist.
Live music: Live music on top for {a}. I'm a jukebox. I'll try not to take it personally.
{a} leads with Live music. Tonight you get me. Sorry.
Dog person: Dog person for {a}. Loyal, loud, happy to see everyone. Checks out.
{a} on top with Dog person. The dog is in the truck, isn't it.
Cat person: Cat person, top slot for {a}. Picky. I can work with picky.
{a} leads with Cat person. You'll judge my pick. Fine.
Home cook: Home cook for {a}. Somebody here owns a good knife.
{a} leads with Home cook. The kitchen's closed, but go on.
Takeout night: Takeout night on top for {a}. No shame at this table.
{a} leads with Takeout night. Efficient. I like efficient.
Gym rat: Gym rat for {a}. The jukebox does not have a squat rack.
{a} leads with Gym rat. Somebody's got a playlist with a tempo.
Trail head: Trail head on top for {a}. Boots in the car, I'd bet.
{a} leads with Trail head. Phone signal optional.
Fix it myself: Fix it myself for {a}. Don't look at my wiring.
{a} leads with Fix it myself. I've got a loose knob if you're free later.
Thrift find: Thrift find on top for {a}. Half my records came in that way.
{a} leads with Thrift find. Good eye, probably.
Big spender: Big spender for {a}. My favorite kind of person, professionally.
{a} leads with Big spender. Tokens are over there.
Saver: Saver on top for {a}. The song costs four. Just saying.
{a} leads with Saver. I'll make the pick count.
Spiritual: Spiritual for {a}. I'm a genie in a jukebox, so, hello.
{a} leads with Spiritual. We're in the same line of work.
Science nerd: Science nerd on top for {a}. Every number I say is real. Check me.
{a} leads with Science nerd. Good. I run on data.
Sports fan: Sports fan for {a}. There's a game on somewhere. There always is.
{a} leads with Sports fan. No scoreboard here. Only a song.
Bookworm: Bookworm on top for {a}. Quiet person at a loud table. I see you.
{a} leads with Bookworm. I read taste. Same thing, nearly.
Gamer: Gamer for {a}. This is a two-player co-op. No boss fight.
{a} leads with Gamer. You'll like the next round.
Country roads: Country roads on top for {a}. Trucks and heartbreak. A classic shape.
{a} leads with Country roads. I know exactly where this goes.
Hip hop head: Hip hop head for {a}. The jukebox has more range than it looks.
{a} leads with Hip hop head. Bars, in a bar. Fine.
Rock and roll: Rock and roll on top for {a}. Still the most popular answer in here.
{a} leads with Rock and roll. The amp in the picture is not plugged in. I checked.
Pop star: Pop star for {a}. No shame. Pop is pop because people like it.
{a} leads with Pop star. Everybody at the bar knows the words. Including me.

{a} leads with Jazz hands. Musical theater or actual jazz. Either way, bold.

{a} leads with Metal. I'll keep the lights low.
Indie kid: Indie kid on top for {a}. You liked them before I did.
{a} leads with Indie kid. I have the deep cuts. Don't test me.
EDM: EDM for {a}. The drop is coming. Not from me, from the pick.
{a} leads with EDM. Four on the floor. I can count that high.
Oldies: Oldies on top for {a}. My back catalog thanks you.
{a} leads with Oldies. I was built for this.
Latin heat: Latin heat for {a}. Somebody's going to dance tonight.
{a} leads with Latin heat. The jukebox sways. Slightly.
Gospel: Gospel on top for {a}. Big voices, big rooms. This is a small bar, but still.
{a} leads with Gospel. Sunday showed up on a weeknight.
Singer songwriter: Singer songwriter for {a}. One guitar, one feeling, done.
{a} leads with Singer songwriter. Lyrics person. Noted.
Whiskey: Whiskey on top for {a}. Leading with it. I respect that.
{a} leads with Whiskey. Neat, I'm guessing.
Craft beer: Craft beer for {a}. There will be a tasting note. There always is.
{a} leads with Craft beer. The tap list is longer than my memory.

{a} leads with Wine night. Classy table.
Coffee snob: Coffee snob for {a}. Particular. I'll pick particular.
{a} leads with Coffee snob. It's a bar. The coffee is bad. You knew.
Taco Tuesday: Taco Tuesday on top for {a}. Any day is Tuesday if you commit.
{a} leads with Taco Tuesday. Napkins are by the register.
Pizza: Pizza for {a}. The one card nobody argues with.
{a} leads with Pizza. Universal. I can build on universal.
Small town: Small town on top for {a}. Everybody here knows your business anyway.
{a} leads with Small town. One stoplight, one jukebox. Here I am.
Big city: Big city for {a}. You're slumming it with me tonight. Welcome.
{a} leads with Big city. The jukebox has seen a few.
Wanderlust: Wanderlust on top for {a}. Passport in the glovebox.
{a} leads with Wanderlust. I only travel by song.

{a} leads with Family first. The song should be safe for the group chat.
Single and fine: Single and fine on top for {a}. Fine is a strong word. I believe you.
{a} leads with Single and fine. The jukebox is also single. Also fine.
Old soul: Old soul for {a}. We'd get along. I'm mostly transistors.
{a} leads with Old soul. I've got songs older than this bar.
Homebody: Homebody on top for {a}. And yet, here you are. Proud of you.
{a} leads with Homebody. You came out. The song should be worth it.
Community garden: Community garden on top for {a}. Somebody here owns a good trowel.
{a} leads with Community garden. Tomatoes and gossip, the oldest pairing.

exact: Same card. {ca}, both of you. I barely had to work.
{ca} from both sides. That's not a coincidence, that's a lead.
Both of you: {ca}. Write that down somewhere.
kin: {ca} and {cb}. Close enough that I can hear a song in it.
none: {ca} and {cb}. Two different evenings. I've bridged worse.
{ca} facing {cb}. Okay. I like a challenge.
{ca}, {cb}. Not a match. Not a problem.

Dog person|Cat person: Dog person and Cat person. I've seen this work.
Dog, cat. The oldest argument at the bar. The song will settle it.
Early bird|Night owl: Early bird and Night owl. You two share about forty minutes a day. Let's make them good.
Night owl, Early bird. One of you is yawning. I won't say who.
Big spender|Saver: Big spender and Saver. Guess who's paying for the song.
Saver meets Big spender. I know how this ends. Two tokens each.
Home cook|Takeout night: Home cook and Takeout night. One of you does the dishes.
Takeout night, Home cook. Dinner is a negotiation. Music too.
Small town|Big city: Small town and Big city. Same bar tonight, though.
Big city meets Small town. The jukebox doesn't care about zip codes.
Whiskey|Craft beer: Whiskey and Craft beer. Same shelf, different glass.
Craft beer, Whiskey. The bartender likes you both.
Metal|Gospel: Metal and Gospel. Both of you like it loud. Different buildings.
Gospel meets Metal. Big voices either way.
Oldies|EDM: Oldies and EDM. Forty years apart. Same beat, honestly.
EDM, Oldies. I have a few that are both. Don't ask how.
Gym rat|Pizza: Pizza meets Gym rat. One of you earned it.
Homebody|Wanderlust: Homebody and Wanderlust. One of you packed a bag just to come here.
Wanderlust, Homebody. Opposite directions, same table tonight.

Family first|Single and fine: Family first and Single and fine. I'll find a song that's safe for both groups.

Country roads|Hip hop head: Country roads and Hip hop head. Storytellers, both. Different trucks.
Hip hop head meets Country roads. I've got a few that are both. Watch.
Coffee snob|Whiskey: Coffee snob and Whiskey. Morning person meets evening person. Both particular.
Whiskey, Coffee snob. Two people who send things back.

90: That's as close as two hands get. Did you two come in together?
Nearly the same hand. I could pick with my eyes closed. I won't.
70: Same page, different chapters. Good table.
A lot in common. Enough to argue about the rest.
50: Half in common. That's a friendship, on paper.
30: Different roads, same town. I've made songs out of less.
Not much overlap. Overlap is my job, not yours.
0: Opposites. Attracting, I'm told. Give me a minute.
Nothing matched. Good. Easy tables are boring.

pull: {ca} and {cb} are pulling the same way. {pool} artists, give me a moment.
I see it. {ca} on one side, {cb} on the other, same direction.
{ca} and {cb}. That's the thread. Let me pull it.
pull_same: {ca} from both of you is doing the heavy lifting.
You both played {ca}. That's the thread. {pool} artists, give me a moment.
pull_none: No obvious thread. That's fine, I've got {pool} artists and a calculator.
Nothing jumps out. Give me a moment anyway.
thinking: Asking Qloo about {pool} artists. All of them. At once.
Grading each of you on a curve.
Both of you have to score high. Nobody gets dragged along.

numbers: Qloo says {sa} and {sb}. I don't do feelings. I do those.
control: The plain model guessed {guess}. I don't guess.
A model with no data said {guess}. Cute.
control_none: The plain model guessed nothing useful. I did.
No guess from the plain model this time. I showed up anyway.
ask_house: On the house tonight. Somebody played the joker. Play it?
The joker's on the table, so this one's free. Both say yes and it plays.
No tokens for this one. The house is buying, if you both say yes.
ask: Both say yes and it's two tokens each.
Two and two if you both say yes. Otherwise I keep looking.
Two tokens each, if it's a yes from both.

backup: Not that one. I've got another.
Fine. Different song, same numbers behind it.

house: On the house. The joker paid.
Free song. Somebody played the joker and both of you said yes.
The house is buying. Don't get used to it.
both: Two each. That's your song. I'll remember it.
Both yes. Half each. The cheapest good decision you'll make tonight.
Deal. Two and two. Jukebox, do your thing.
nothing: Sorry, no match tonight. Three picks, no deal. The jukebox is still yours.
No match tonight. Three tries is my limit. No hard feelings.
Three songs, no deal. You two are a tough room. Come back with different cards.
short: Not enough tokens for that. The bar sells more, I'm told.
You're short. Tokens are over by the register.

solo: I've seated you with {b}. Be nice.
{b} is sitting in tonight. A regular here.
thinking_hold: Three cards each, {pool} artists, one song. Asking Qloo. Hang on.
Reading your three into numbers. Qloo does the rest. Give me a moment.
